overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan review recent Medford updates, including the ratification of the teachers' contract and reflections on a School Committee meeting. Community members and local students also share their personal highlights from 2022 and hopes for 2023.

items.title: Podcast Introduction
items.summary: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan open the final episode of the year for the Medford Bytes podcast.

items.title: Teacher Contract Ratification and School Committee Reflections
items.summary: The hosts review the ratification of the three-year teachers' contract and reflect on community concerns, student wellbeing, and district leadership following a heavy School Committee meeting.

items.title: 2022 Highlights and 2023 Hopes
items.summary: The hosts, local eighth-grade students from Andrews Middle School, and Medford community members share highlights from 2022 and look ahead to 2023.
